page.overview:
What is Français Pour Une Nuit?

Français Pour Une Nuit ("French for One Night") was recorded in Nîmes, France in the Arena of Nîmes on July 7, 2009 during the World Magnetic Tour.

Despite only being issued in France, it has been imported in sufficient quantity to be considered a regular release.

It is also the first release to include live version of "Dyers Eve", earlier live recording of this song was released a few days later on Orgullo, Pasión, y Gloria, but only on special edition's bonus DVD.
